text:
oncall-bot: Pager: billing.alerts.token-count-tilt triggered (count drift vs baseline). Priority: P2. Please pick up.

oncall-bot: Current symptom: gradual token count increase from collector-a in eu-west1 over last 90m. No customer billing pages yet but overage flags rising in shadow reports.

irene: I’m on it. I’ll take triage — switching to incident channel. @ryan can you confirm if any deploys hit collector-a around 90m ago?

ryan: Confirmed — small deploy rolled 2:12 UTC to collector-a (metrics-collector v1.3.4). Release note: change to sample rate fallback. Rolling back now to v1.3.3.

irene: Reverting deploy. Command: `kubectl -n telemetry rollout undo deployment/metrics-collector --to-revision=3`

billing-ops: Seeing a 6% delta on shadow counts for last 2 windows, trending up. Overage flag count increased from 1 -> 12 customers in shadow. No live invoice spikes yet.

alex: Quick check log snippet from collector-a (last 5m):
```
WARN sampler: fallback hit, defaulting to full-count
INFO emit: emitted batch size=13872 tokens
DEBUG request_id=abcd-1234 sampling_prob=0.000
```

irene: That debug line looks like sampler sending full-count when it should be probabilistic. If rollback completes, we should see sampling_prob go back to expected 0.1-0.2.

oncall-bot: Rollback to v1.3.3 succeeded on collector-a (2:23 UTC). Monitoring for stabilization; expected signal in 2 windows (~10m).

billing-ops: After rollback, shadow delta down to 2% in last window. Overage flag creation stopped. Still need reconciliation for windows between 2:12-2:23.

ryan: Kicking a soft mitigation: disable emitter on collector-a for replay window to prevent double-counting while backfill pipeline handles reconciliation. `kubectl patch deployment/metrics-collector -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"emit-disabled":"true"}}}}}'`

alex: Noted. Also starting a partial replay blocker: setting kafka consumer group pause for collector-a to avoid duplicate replays while we backfill.

customer-ops: Heads-up — prepare a short note if customers ask. Recommend message: "We detected and mitigated a brief metering issue affecting shadow usage reports between 02:12–02:23 UTC. No customer charges were applied from shadow reports; we are reconciling and will update if any billable impact is found."

irene: Agree. I’ll draft the message. Also start a quick recon job: `python infra/tools/reconcile_shadow.py --start 2024-03-12T02:12:00Z --end 2024-03-12T02:23:00Z --target=ledger-staging` -> ETA ~8m.

billing-ops: Recon job running. Early output: ~14 customers with >0.5% token delta, 2 customers flagged >5% — flagged for manual review.

oncall-bot: Incident summary (auto): root cause: sampler fallback behavior introduced in metrics-collector v1.3.4 causing full-count emissions; mitigation: rollback to v1.3.3, emitter disabled on collector-a, kafka consumer pause; next: reconcile shadow -> ledger, customer comms draft.

ryan: Postmortem note: add unit test for sampler fallback path and a canary metric that alerts on sudden change in sampling_prob distribution.

irene: Will own postmortem and comms. Tagging @customer-ops for approval on message and billing-ops for final ledger check before closing.

customer-ops: Ack — will prepare external-facing blurb if manual review finds billable impact.

billing-ops: Manual review finished: no billable impact found after reconciliation; shadow flags were false positives. We’ll close the incident after a quick watch window (30m) and file follow-up for tests and canary.

irene: Closing notes: incident resolved, follow-ups: (1) add sampler unit tests, (2) add canary metric and >2% shadow-change SLO alert, (3) run full audit for emitter-disabled windows. I’ll file the postmortem by EOD. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Incident closed by irene at 03:05 UTC.
